detail: Unbacked wrapped-token mint: this wrapped / bridge token's mint has NO bridge-role gate, so anyone can mint the wrapped asset without any corresponding lock or burn on the origin chain - instant unbacked supply.

Fee-on-transfer deposit overcredit: the deposit path pulls tokens with transferFrom and credits the NOMINAL amount parameter as shares / balance, without measuring how much actually arrived (balanceOf before vs after). A fee-on-transfer, rebasing-down or otherwise short-delivering token is credited at face value, and the credited position redeems against the full pool - the shortfall is taken from the other depositors. Observed: 'deposit' pulls 'amount' with transferFrom and credits it at face value (_mint credit to recipient) with no balanceOf delta measurement anywhere in the function. Gate
